independent_research_owner: Energy Research contributor only, Amalgam PR #1278 sole cumulative integration authority
falsifiable_question: At 20% observation noise, separate the effects of truncating the OLD posterior, restricting NEW candidate radius, and conservative alarm cutoffs on change detection at matched NULL-only calibration budgets.

frozen_design.world_family: Source-free five-bit binary XOR mask/bias (62 hypotheses), OLD 24 samples and NEW 16 fixed common input/outcome interventions, first 12 distinct inputs; 20% Bernoulli observation flip. Four families NULL, SINGLE_EDGE, DOUBLE_EDGE, NONLINEAR_AND (NEW XOR law with two-input AND outside 62 hypotheses).
frozen_design.hypothesis_prior: Uniform OLD hypotheses, P(structural change)=0.25; conditional change transition kernel exp(-Hamming(mask XOR)-bias difference) with NEW!=OLD, normalized for every retained OLD anchor.
frozen_design.topk: For top8/top4, rank OLD posterior descending; retain until cumulative posterior mass >=.95 or cap reached, then renormalize. Full retains all 62 OLD, map retains 1.
frozen_design.new_search: local2 uses candidate NEW hypotheses with mask-bit Hamming <=2 and both bias options, excluding unchanged. global uses all 61 changed hypotheses; identical assumed transition kernel renormalized over considered alternatives.

calibration.rule: For each arm sort the same independent 200 NULL-only calibration posterior-change scores. 95% cutoff ascending one-based rank ceil(.95*(200+1))=191; conservative 98% ascending rank ceil(.98*(201))=197. Never change after scoring held worlds.

primary.separation: Disjoint from calibration, smoke and previous Gate14-20 seed sets; all arms receive exact same OLD observations and 16 NEW input/outcome pairs; latent source withheld from models.

frozen_design.metrics: For each of 6 arms and 2 fixed NULL-derived thresholds: held NULL false-alarm rate, changed familiar causal sensitivity across 192 SINGLE+DOUBLE worlds, nonlinear shift sensitivity on 96 out-of-family worlds; continuous event-posterior Brier on 288 familiar worlds; OLD selected hypothesis count/mass, 16 action/outcome trace, exact same-process JSON OLD posterior/readout roundtrip, likelihood/prior operation count proxy (not real speed).

tests.factorial: At each matched cutoff report top8global vs top8local2 (NEW search), fullLocal vs top8local (OLD truncation), fullGlobal vs fullLocal, fullGlobal vs top8global; only the first two identify single levers without mixing.
tests.calibration: For same posterior model, report 95pct vs 98pct cutoff effect on false alarms and sensitivity. These are pre-frozen alternatives, not per-primary tuning.
tests.audit: Store 200 raw NULL scores by arm; independently recompute both ranks and per-world metrics from retained primary rows, paired differences without regenerating consumed worlds.

frozen_verdict.mechanism_identified_signal: A 95pct-calibrated single lever (NEW radius expanded at top8 OLD, or OLD full instead of top8 at local2 NEW) improves familiar change sensitivity >=0.12 (12 percentage points) vs old_top8_new_local2, AND has held NULL false-alarm rate <=0.08 and <= full_global NULL FPR +0.04, AND no deterioration of familiar event-Brier >0.025 compared with candidate. For attribution, 95pct other lever's gain must be at least 0.05 smaller than identified lever's gain. If both levers similar, result is nonisolated.
frozen_verdict.strong_control: Best recovered low-cost candidate should be no more than 0.10 below full OLD/new global strong Bayesian familiar sensitivity at 95pct; otherwise engineering mechanism hint only and still NO_GO.
frozen_verdict.calibration_guard: Both 95pct and 98pct threshold outcomes explicitly reported; primary cannot select the more favorable after seeing results.
frozen_verdict.classification: All criteria => DEV_MECHANISM_SIGNAL_UNQUALIFIED only, not SCIENTIFIC_PASS; otherwise SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO. If none of the levers improves sensitivity enough, stop speculative threshold adjustment.
frozen_verdict.engineering: Single frozen source after committed prereg; Git source readback before one disjoint smoke, 200-calibration and one 384-world primary. Save raw calibration scores, ALL primary posterior scores/action traces. Separate postscore arithmetic audit no simulation rerun. Full final regression on candidate SHA separately required.
